purpose: Show the stable core of Mediterranean dietary patterns, the components that vary across definitions, and the common single-ingredient or fixed-menu interpretations that the evidence does not support.
title: A Mediterranean diet is a pattern, not one fixed menu
story: The recurring core is a plant-forward replacement pattern built around vegetables, fruit, legumes, nuts, minimally refined grains, olive oil and fish.
Published definitions vary in dairy, alcohol, portion sizes, scoring cut-offs and local staple foods.
The evidence does not support treating olive oil alone, wine, automatic calorie restriction or one geographically fixed menu as the intervention.
observed: Systematic reviews of definitions identify a recurring plant-forward core but substantial variation in operational criteria and adherence scores.
Trial programmes measure a whole dietary pattern and often provide counselling or foods.
inferred: The replacement arrow is a synthesis of the recurring pattern rather than a quantified dose-response relation; label it as a pattern-level substitution.
layout_notes: Use one continuous left-to-right comparison on a white 3:2 landscape canvas, with three lower-case labelled regions separated mainly by white space and thin neutral leaders rather than boxed cards.
In region a, arrange recognizable flat scientific food-group silhouettes around a central thin replacement arrow; local labels must sit in quiet white space.
In region b, use a pale dashed boundary around the components that vary across definitions.
In region c, use four restrained crossed-out interpretations as plain text with thin neutral strike marks; do not use warning icons, badges, shields or decorative food photography.
constraints: Arial throughout; all labels at least 20 px at a 1536 px canvas width.
Keep the title outside the artwork because this is an article figure.
Use pale green, blue and ochre only for semantic grouping; keep all prose black or near-black.
The dashed boundary means definitions vary, not that those components are unimportant.
Do not imply a numerical effect size, serving prescription or mandatory alcohol intake.
exact_text: A Mediterranean diet is a pattern, not one fixed menu
Olive oil as the main added fat
Fish more often than red or processed meat
